_doc: GT fuel MMBTU reverse-norm constants per CPP, from 'GT_HRSG_AB MMBTU_Calculation.xls' (sheet 'BPC Power loading and MMBTU'). Net GT fuel norm (MMBTU/kWh) = kcal_to_btu * (GrossHeatRate_kcal_kwh - SUM_tier[ FSF_tier * (SteamTemp_tier - ReferenceTemp) / efficiency ]) / 1e6. Which tiers apply to a given GT is detected at runtime from the linked HRSG's byproduct steam rows (negative norms in the ODS consumption norms): no byproduct = primary tier only, one byproduct = primary + that grade, two byproducts = all three tiers. Primary tier FSF comes from the interpolated DB FreeSteamFactor whenever available - the configured value is only its fallback (MP/LP tiers have no curve and always use the configured fsf). The heat rate is interpolated from the DB heat-rate curve at the dispatched MW. Optional per-GT pinning: add an 'asset_overrides' object under a plant keyed by exact asset name, e.g. "asset_overrides": {"JMD - C2-GTG 2": {"heat_rate": 2678.0, "tiers": {"SHP": {"fsf": 1.60}}}} - override tier entries merge over the plant tiers. Update numbers here to revise the calculation - no code change needed.
